title: fix: add missing test-env placeholders so the enter suite can run locally
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Three values the test env was missing (or had too short) made **63 of 781** enter tests fail on a dev machine. All placeholders — no real credentials.

- `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` — absent. The Stripe tests use the mock in `test/mocks/stripe.ts` and never reach Stripe, but the SDK refuses to construct with an undefined key (`src/utils/stripe.ts:7`), so every route 500'd.
- `PLN_ENTER_TOKEN` — was 16 chars; `isInternalRequest()` requires ≥32 (`src/routes/stripe.ts:327`), so `/auto-top-up/trigger` 401'd on all 11 of its tests.

All three go in `[env.test.vars]`, alongside the existing test placeholders. The `.dev.vars.test` shadow stays as-is — it deliberately keeps decrypted secrets out of tests so `TINYBIRD_INGEST_URL` can't point at live staging.

### Result

`enter` full suite: **63 failed → 5 failed** (775 passed). `test/integration/stripe.test.ts` goes 58 failed → **66/66 passing**.

The remaining 5 have a different cause and are tracked in #13475:
- `test/integration/account-keys.test.ts` — 3
- `test/account-key.test.ts` — 1
- `test/docs-redirect.test.ts` — 1

Addresses #13475

gist.headline: The test hive wakes up
gist.blurb: A few harmless dummy keys were enough to stop the local enter suite from mistaking itself for production. The Stripe test garden is buzzing again.
gist.summary: Added placeholder STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and a 32-character PLN_ENTER_TOKEN to enter.pollinations.ai's test environment, reducing local enter-suite failures from 63 to 5 and restoring all 66 Stripe integration tests.
gist.impact: Contributors can now run the enter test suite locally with mocked Stripe routes initializing correctly and auto-top-up trigger tests authenticating as intended.
